text: Recently, I have heard from the homeowner of 19 Silverthorn Avenue requesting bollard repair and replacement along the flankage of their property. Bollards act as both a physical and visual barrier, protecting people and property from damage without impeding the public right of way. In the reported case, the resident has a fence around their front yard and bollards along its flankage, which have been damaged because of vehicle impact. As a result, I am recommending that the damaged bollards be replaced in order to protect property and enhance community safety.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Directed the General Manager, Transportation Services, to replace the bollards in the first public lane north of St. Clair Avenue West and east of Silverthorn Avenue along the flankage of 19 Silverthorn Avenue.
